description: Orbit math evaluated by KSP's Orbit class (direct calls on the shipped-IL-equivalent assembly). Frame: KSP 'zup' local frame returned by getRelativePositionAtUT / getOrbitalVelocityAtUT (Planetarium.Zup.WorldToLocal applied; Zup = PlanetaryFrame(0,90,0) = identity up to ~6e-17 terms). Angles: inclination/LAN/argPe in degrees, anomalies in radians. Central bodies use in-game mu (see bodies dataset).

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono
